{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="date">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' take place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] used a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] taken from a [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] dealer named [[Jervis Gloom]] to '''infiltrate''' [[Haugg Nerf Industries]], a [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]]-packing plant used as a front for selling [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]], which was located in the [[Industrial District/Legends|Industrial District]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Fett came to the facility in search of information from the plant's owner, a man named [[Groff Haugg]], on [[Komari Vosa]], the leader of a secretive criminal cult known as the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]]. After fighting many of the facility's [[Guineo]] and [[Draag]] guards Fett found that [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]], another Mandalorian bounty hunter, had managed to reach Haugg first and had [[Death/Legends|killed]] Haugg by freezing him in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] after obtaining information from him. However, Haugg lied to Montross due to his fear of Vosa, and Fett was able to discover one of Haugg's associates, a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] named [[Connus Trell]].<ref name="SWBH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
